name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
label: Quest
description: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Vivian Lagrave sent me word from Kargath, in the Badlands. Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within Blackrock Spire that would benefit our research. To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire. No easy task.
If interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is true. I believe there is a tablet held within Blackrock Spire, a tablet that contains old alchemical recipes. I am glad you are here, for I need help in retrieving the tablet.
Make yourself comfortable, and I will explain further.
